heading: Meet Josh
text: Commissioner Joshua Wostal is a successful entrepreneur, decorated veteran, and passionate advocate for working families and disadvantaged children. Elected as Commissioner in 2022, Wostal has brought accountability and transparency to the board to stop wasteful spending.

heading: Meet Josh
text: As a job creator himself, he owns and operates a general contracting business. Wostal served our country in the Navy for 10 years and received the Navy Commendation for acts of courage during Taliban attacks on his forward operating base. He has a heart for disadvantaged children and gives back to local children advocacy groups and causes. He and his wife live in the Westchase area of Hillsborough County with their son, daughter, and 3 rescue pets.

heading: The 'Boring' Budget Guy
text: I'm not a politician — I'm just a regular guy who focuses on getting the job done. Here is where I'm fighting for Hillsborough County taxpayers.

heading: End Wasteful Spending
text: Before I took office, I knew our Hillsborough County government was wasting our tax dollars, but I didn't realize to what extent. Most residents don't, because who has the time to comb through an 850-page, nearly $10 billion budget?

heading: Stop the Tax Hikes
text: Here in Hillsborough County, we pay the 3rd highest sales taxes in the state. The county maxes their property tax levy every single year. They impose 3 separate gas taxes. They increased our water bills by 4%.

heading: Fix Our Crumbling Infrastructure
text: Our infrastructure in Hillsborough County is crumbling despite county government collecting billions in tax dollars earmarked for infrastructure. Year over year, our government approved record funding into road maintenance and repaving.

heading: Join the Fight for Working Families
text: Whether you can volunteer an hour, put up a yard sign, or chip in to help us reach voters, every bit of support keeps a taxpayer advocate on the Hillsborough County Board.

heading: Privacy Policy
text: This Privacy Policy ("Policy") applies to https://joshuawostal.com/ and Joshua Wostal, Republican, for Board of County Commissioner District 7 ("Committee") and governs data collection and usage. For the purposes of this Privacy Policy, unless otherwise noted, all references to the Committee include https://joshuawostal.com/. The Committee's website is a fundraising and informational site. By using the Committee's website, you consent to the data practices described in this statement.

heading: Collection of Your Personal Information

However, you may be required to provide certain personal information to us when you elect to use certain products or services. These may include: (a) registering for an account; (b) entering a sweepstakes or contest sponsored by us or one of our partners; (c) signing up for special offers from selected third parties; (d) sending us an email message; (e) submitting your credit card or other payment information when ordering and purchasing products and services.

heading: Collection of Your Personal Information

heading: Sharing Information with Third Parties
text: The Committee does not sell, rent, or lease its customer lists to third parties.

heading: Sharing Information with Third Parties
text: Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties unless required by law.

heading: Sharing Information with Third Parties
text: The Committee may share data with trusted partners to help perform statistical analysis, send you email or postal mail, provide customer support, or arrange for deliveries. All such third parties are prohibited from using your personal information except to provide these services to the Committee, and they are required to maintain the confidentiality of your information.

heading: Sharing Information with Third Parties
text: The Committee may disclose your personal information, without notice, if required to do so by law or in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to: (a) conform to the edicts of the law or comply with legal process served on the Committee or the site; (b) protect and defend the rights or property of the Committee; and/or (c) act under exigent circumstances to protect the personal safety of users of the Committee, or the public.

heading: Third-Party Services
text: This website embeds forms and payment pages hosted by third-party providers, including Anedot for contributions and Cognito Forms for volunteer sign-ups. Information you submit through those embedded forms is collected and processed by those providers under their own privacy policies in addition to this one.

heading: Third-Party Services
text: Some pages embed video using the YouTube player. YouTube may set cookies and receive your IP address when a page containing the player loads, whether or not you play the video, and processes that information under Google's privacy policy.

heading: Automatically Collected Information
text: The Committee may automatically collect information about your computer hardware and software. This information can include your IP address, browser type, domain names, access times, and referring website addresses. This information is used for the operation of the service, to maintain quality of the service, and to provide general statistics regarding the use of the Committee's website.

heading: Automatically Collected Information
text: This website uses Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors use the site. Both set cookies and collect information such as the pages you visit, how long you stay, your approximate location, and details about your device and browser. Microsoft Clarity additionally records how you interact with pages, including mouse movement, scrolling, and clicks, and may replay those recorded sessions. This information is processed by Google and Microsoft under their own privacy policies. You can opt out of Google Analytics using the browser add-on Google provides for that purpose.

heading: Automatically Collected Information
text: This website also uses Google Ads conversion tracking to measure the results of the Committee's advertising and to build advertising audiences. This may allow the Committee's ads to be shown to you on other websites and services after you visit this site. You can control how Google personalizes the ads you see through Google's Ads Settings.

heading: Security of Your Personal Information
text: The Committee secures your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. The Committee uses the SSL protocol for this purpose. When personal information (such as a credit card number) is transmitted to other websites, it is protected through the use of encryption, such as the Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) protocol.

heading: Security of Your Personal Information
text: We strive to take appropriate security measures to protect against unauthorized access to or alteration of your personal information. Unfortunately, no data transmission over the Internet or any wireless network can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your personal information, you acknowledge that: (a) there are security and privacy limitations inherent to the Internet that are beyond our control; and (b) the security, integrity, and privacy of any and all information and data exchanged between you and us through this site cannot be guaranteed.

text: Subject to certain exceptions set out below, on receipt of a verifiable request from you, we will:

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Delete your personal information from our records; and

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Direct any service providers to delete your personal information from their records.

heading: Right to Deletion

text: Complete the transaction for which the personal information was collected, fulfill the terms of a written warranty or product recall conducted in accordance with federal law, and provide a good or service requested by you, or reasonably anticipated within the context of our ongoing business relationship with you, or otherwise perform a contract between you and us;

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Detect security incidents, protect against malicious, deceptive, fraudulent, or illegal activity; or prosecute those responsible for that activity;

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Debug to identify and repair errors that impair existing intended functionality;

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Exercise free speech, ensure the right of another consumer to exercise his or her right of free speech, or exercise another right provided for by law;

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Comply with the California Electronic Communications Privacy Act;

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Engage in public or peer-reviewed scientific, historical, or statistical research in the public interest that adheres to all other applicable ethics and privacy laws, when our deletion of the information is likely to render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of such research, provided we have obtained your informed consent;

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Enable solely internal uses that are reasonably aligned with your expectations based on your relationship with us;

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Comply with an existing legal obligation; or

heading: Right to Deletion
text: Otherwise use your personal information, internally, in a lawful manner that is compatible with the context in which you provided the information.

heading: Children Under Thirteen
text: The Committee does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under the age of 13. If you are under the age of 13, you must ask your parent or guardian for permission to use this website.

heading: Email Communications
text: From time to time, the Committee may contact you via email for the purpose of providing announcements, promotional offers, alerts, confirmations, surveys, and/or other general communication. In order to improve our services, we may receive a notification when you open an email from the Committee or click on a link therein.

heading: Email Communications
text: If you would like to stop receiving marketing or promotional communications via email from the Committee, you may opt out of such communications by unsubscribing in the footer of any emails or by contacting the Committee directly.

heading: Changes to This Statement
text: The Committee reserves the right to change this Policy from time to time. For example, when there are changes in our services, changes in our data protection practices, or changes in the law. When changes to this Policy are significant, we will inform you. You may receive a notice by sending an email to the primary email address specified in your account, by placing a prominent notice on our website, and/or by updating any privacy information. Your continued use of the website and/or services available after such modifications will constitute your: (a) acknowledgment of the modified Policy; and (b) agreement to abide and be bound by that Policy.
